lines.t: (Verse 1)
I walked through shadows, chasing the dawn,
Heard the whisper of truth calling me home.
In the silence, Your voice remains,
Gentle as mercy, strong as flame.
(Pre-Chorus)
Every tear was a seed of light,
Every fall was a step toward life.
Now I rise, not by my might —
But by the Word that speaks through night.
(Chorus)
You are the Light that speaks, unbroken,
Through the storms, Your love is spoken.
Every heart You call, awoken —
By grace, by truth, by fire.
(Verse 2)
From the dust, You formed my song,
Carved Your name where I belong.
The heavens echo, mountains bow,
The breath of God is here and now.
(Pre-Chorus)
Every shadow bends to grace,
Every fear dissolves in faith.
Now I see with open eyes —
The Living Truth will never die.
(Chorus)
You are the Light that speaks, unbroken,
Through the storms, Your love is spoken.
Every heart You call, awoken —
By grace, by truth, by fire.
Let the oceans hear, let the skies reply,
Your voice still echoes through all time.
No chain remains, no wall stands high,
Your Word has opened every sky.
You are the Light that speaks, unbroken,
Every soul You’ve ever chosen.
Hope resounds, the night is stolen —
By love, by truth, by fire.
In stillness, I hear You near,
The Light that speaks — I see it clear.
